business_summary: Route Mobile Limited provides cloud-communication platform solutions to enterprises, over-the-top service providers, and mobile network operators in India and internationally. The company offers messaging, voice, e-mail, enhanced business messaging, identity and verification, bespoke solutions, and other solutions. It also provides A2P messaging that includes SMS, 2-way messaging, and Acculync; enterprise email communication, RCS messaging, and OTT messaging solutions; voice application services; voice services comprising interactive voice response, Click2Call, missed call facility, and outbound dialer; and communications platform and managed service solutions, such as A2P SMS firewall and filtering, analytics, monetization, hubbing, SMSC, and MMSC solutions to mobile network operators. In addition, the company offers digital identity and security services; business process outsourcing (BPO) voice services, such as customer care, technical support, and booking assistance and payment collection services; and non-voice services comprising client support through email and chat, IT helpdesk, and billing and data processing. Additionally, it provides short message service (SMS) filtering, analytics, SMS firewall, SMSC, MMSC, and SMS monetization solutions. The company offers its cloud-communication services to clients in the banking and financial, aviation, retail, e-commerce, logistics, healthcare, hospitality, media and entertainment, pharmaceutical, and telecom sectors. Route Mobile Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. The company operates as a subsidiary of Proximus Global SA.
